comparisons.name: print-bottom-edge-light
comparisons.description: The bottom of the Print sheet over the white page of the TextEdit window behind it, Aqua: the sheet material, the 0.5 pt edge and the shadow's falloff. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: print-bottom-edge-dark
comparisons.description: The bottom of the Print sheet over the dark page of the TextEdit window behind it, Dark Aqua: the sheet material, the 1 pt rim, the dark 0.5 pt edge and the shadow. No text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: attachment-light
comparisons.description: A whole sheet hanging from its line, Aqua: no shadow above the line, the fill, the edge and the shadow below.

pixels.note: the page 1.5 pt above the line: a sheet casts no shadow there (measured: the toolbar keeps its colours, spec sheet)
the same beside the sheet, above the line
fill: the sheet material over white, computed from the token; #efefef measured on the Print sheet
the 0.5 pt edge under the sheet, measured on Light-Print @ 800,1042

comparisons.name: attachment-dark
comparisons.description: A whole sheet hanging from its line, Dark Aqua: no shadow above the line, the fill, the rim and the edge.

pixels.note: the page 1.5 pt above the line: a sheet casts no shadow there (inferred from the light capture)
fill: the sheet material over #1e1e1e, computed from the token
the 1 pt rim inside the bottom edge: white at 20% over the fill, computed; #585758 measured on Dark-Print @ 800,1010 over that capture's lighter fill
the 0.5 pt edge under the sheet, measured on Dark-Print @ 800,1012

comparisons.name: tall-light
comparisons.description: A sheet with more content than fits below its line, Aqua: it ends inside the page, 5 pt above its bottom, instead of running out of it.

pixels.note: fill: the sheet material over white, computed from the token
the 0.5 pt edge under the sheet, measured on Light-Print @ 800,1042: the sheet ends here, 35 pt below its line

comparisons.name: tall-dark
comparisons.description: A sheet with more content than fits below its line, Dark Aqua: it ends inside the page, 5 pt above its bottom, instead of running out of it.

pixels.note: fill: the sheet material over #1e1e1e, computed from the token
the page under the sheet's bottom edge, darkened by its shadow: #181818 to #1a1a1a measured on Dark-Print @ 800,1013 to 1022. The fill would be #262626
